environment.storage: Local NVMe for all biological inputs, reference, outputs and scratch

method: MSK 30-KO ES three-library arm re-timed on 2026-09-25 with the integrated LARRY lineage caller switched on (star_feature_caller=dominant), so that gene expression, CRISPR guides and LARRY are processed and guides and lineages called in one STAR pass; this is the run the manuscript reports. Everything else is the P02 configuration: the same SHA256-identified 1.9.5 binary, staged inputs, index and feature references, 32 threads, native gzip, GeneFull only and no BAM; the rendered STAR argv is identical after path normalization and the multi-library configuration differs only in the caller column. Protocol as before: quiet host, page cache dropped first, every locus asserted on NVMe, whole-process wall time from GNU time. The quiet gate sampled live CPU (2 s) because idle resident processes from an unrelated analysis carried a high lifetime-average CPU while using none; the CPU time of every other process was recorded across the run (296 CPU-seconds in total). Cell Ranger 9.0.1 outputs and the summed two-run timing are retained.

evidence.validation: Passed wrapper completion and output acceptance: all 28 output files shared with the caller-off P02 run are byte-identical (GeneFull matrix, CRISPR calls and ambient FDR, raw and filtered feature matrices), so the concordance values of the P02 record carry over unchanged; the LARRY calls equal those of the 2026-09-20 1.9.5 caller-on release-acceptance run row for row (order differs).
evidence.larry_caller: dominant (top count greater than runner-up; a tie gives no call)

limitations: Supersedes the MSK row of paper-2026-perturbseq-v1.9.5 and the caller-off paper-2026-perturbseq-msk-v1.9.5 timing; the A375 row of paper-2026-perturbseq-v1.9.5 remains its accepted measurement.
One timed execution, not a replicated distribution.
The LARRY rule is the one used for the consortium's released lineage calls; matching those calls checks the integration, not the rule's accuracy.
Cell Ranger outputs are a comparator, not ground truth.
